text: The repair declares nsresult rv before checking the header lookup. The author says the declaration was lost during post-review cleanup and the final patch was not locally built. That explains this one-line follow-up without treating earlier approval as final-state build evidence. Current code lives in ExchangeMessageSyncHandler.OnReadStatusChanged and adds an explicit missing-header result; the Rust caller tolerates that one result. No build or read-state synchronization test ran here.
title: The missing read-state result declaration followed post-review cleanup
